nuggets.text: John Madden played both offense and defense for the Mustangs in 1957-58 before becoming a Hall of Fame coach.
At Cal Poly, John Madden once caught a pass from quarterback Bobby Beathard, a future Hall of Famer himself.
John Madden doubled as a catcher on the Cal Poly Mustangs baseball team.
The Mustangs won the 1980 Division II title the same year they beat Boise State, that season's I-AA national champion.
Head coach Tim Skipper was UCLA's interim coach when the Bruins upset No. 7 Penn State 42-37 in 2025.
Tim Skipper ranks second in Fresno State history with 418 career tackles as a linebacker.
Anthony Grigsby Jr. hit Tayvion McCoy for a 34-yard touchdown with 9 seconds left to beat Idaho 38-34 in the opener.
The Mustangs' mascot is Musty the Mustang, and their fight song is 'Ride High, You Mustangs.'
Anthony Grigsby Jr. has thrown 7 touchdown passes in the Mustangs' first two games.
Ray Hall caught touchdown passes of 55 and 35 yards in the Mustangs' win over Central Washington.
